gaps.finding: Authority is distributed among project constitution, reference prose, grammar, capability matrix, executable object packs, tests, and code.
gaps.target: Introduce a feature-scoped authority lock with exactly one authority source per FeatureID.

gaps.finding: The current maintenance order begins with implementation rather than a machine-readable semantic contract.
gaps.target: Move to capsule and conformance first; implementation completes the accepted contract.

gaps.finding: The four-artifact rule covers reference, grammar, examples, and tests but omits exactness, worlds, reference semantics, providers, artifacts, diagnostics, migrations, and agent views.
gaps.target: Replace it with fifteen-projection closure while retaining current G4 gates during transition.

gaps.finding: CAPABILITY.md is manually maintained and collapses parse, admit, execute, evidence, world, and artifact status.
gaps.target: Generate orthogonal status views from capsules, conformance, and implementation coverage.

gaps.finding: Reference prose is normative over grammar, while selected standard-library object packs are also described as executable truth.
gaps.target: Use feature-scoped authority so each feature has one source; distinguish normative language definition from executable distribution.

gaps.finding: The current surface grammar mixes stable syntax, implementation commentary, aspirational rules, and domain-specific productions.
gaps.target: Separate Stage-0 grammar, generated accepted surface, syntax-pack sources, and proposal-only grammar.

gaps.finding: Syntax-pack growth is a decided doctrine but no complete generic pack-to-parser/lowering/formatter/LSP/conformance pipeline is the universal path.
gaps.target: Make syntax-pack compilation a V19 capstone.

gaps.finding: No stable FeatureID joins a concept across grammar, reference, code, worlds, diagnostics, tests, artifacts, and migration.
gaps.target: Adopt FeatureID as the cross-plane join key.

gaps.finding: There is no complete Meaning Spine for dependency, reverse impact, load, migration, test, and agent closure.
gaps.target: Generate a typed feature graph.

gaps.finding: There is no compiled Language Image containing the accepted language and exact identities.
gaps.target: Build deterministic partitioned Language Image and lock.

gaps.finding: There is no explicit Stage-0 boundary or Stage1/Stage2 fixed-point gate.
gaps.target: Define minimal bootstrap and semantic fixed-point comparison.

gaps.finding: ELPs are detailed prose but do not carry one canonical machine-readable Feature Capsule delta.
gaps.target: Adopt ELP v2 with capsule delta and projection closure.

gaps.finding: No Spec Hole object prevents an implementation agent from deciding an unresolved semantic detail.
gaps.target: Make unresolved choices explicit and stable-build blocking when required.

gaps.finding: Quickstart examples use bare declaration names while the current surface EBNF excerpt appears to require a bracketed declaration head.
gaps.target: Resolve through authoritative source cases and goldens; do not let agents choose an interpretation.

gaps.finding: Current status vocabulary mixes maturity, parse support, admission, execution, evidence, artifact disposition, and world coverage.
gaps.target: Use orthogonal status axes.

gaps.finding: There is no standardized cross-layer golden from source bytes through CST, expansion, Core AST, typed HIR, worlds, result, and artifact.
gaps.target: Create a semantic-stack Conformance Corpus.

gaps.finding: Tests are discovered by crate/file rather than indexed by FeatureID and projection.
gaps.target: Generate a Conformance Graph and targeted closure.

gaps.finding: Diagnostics have stable codes, but feature conditions, mathematical explanations, routes, and negative controls are not uniformly one machine record.
gaps.target: Use diagnostic capsules and generated constructors/reference.

gaps.finding: World definitions and capability/evidence manifests are not uniformly one executable capsule per world.
gaps.target: Use World Capsules with applicability, representation, strategy, effects, and authority.

gaps.finding: User-defined worlds remain an open design question without a machine-visible blocker.
gaps.target: Represent it as a Spec Hole and experimental feature decision.

gaps.finding: Phase-1 builtins still live in compiler tables while capability cells/object packs are the intended scalable path.
gaps.target: Migrate leaf builtins with dual-run reference semantics.

gaps.finding: The V16 catalog has 1,224 entries but no uniform catalog-to-specified-to-conformant promotion ledger.
gaps.target: Generate a default catalog-only promotion ledger.

gaps.finding: V15–V18 concepts can be implemented differently by models because the waves are prose authority only.
gaps.target: Provide cross-wave Feature Capsules and conformance slices.

gaps.finding: No root machine manifest tells an agent authority, baseline, invariants, commands, and context budget.
gaps.target: Add AGENT_START.json.

gaps.finding: No generated task-specific read and impact closure exists.
gaps.target: Add Task Capsule, Context Capsule, Impact Closure, and orientation tool.

gaps.finding: Agent decisions, failures, and learned constraints are not append-only language artifacts.
gaps.target: Add Change Receipts and Accretion Ledger.

gaps.finding: File paths and line-number search are brittle semantic anchors under refactors.
gaps.target: Use FeatureID and generated owner/projection anchors.

gaps.finding: No metrics measure agent orientation cost, unnecessary reads, tool calls, or rework.
gaps.target: Add agent-economy fields and acceptance targets.

gaps.finding: Independent implementations lack a complete semantic conformance protocol.
gaps.target: Standardize cross-implementation inputs and comparisons.

gaps.finding: Generated-file policy is distributed and direct edits can be difficult to distinguish.
gaps.target: Use one generated header/lock and CI regeneration gate.

gaps.finding: Legacy and capsule authority could overlap during migration.
gaps.target: Make authority transitions feature-scoped and reject dual authority.

gaps.finding: Router doctrine says nothing is refused at the door, while older documents and capability rows still use refusal language.
gaps.target: Generate a consistent distinction between parse failure, semantic contradiction, routed diagnostic, hole, and runtime fault.

gaps.finding: Current Float64 execution can be labeled numerical even when no rigorous error bound exists, while the public label vocabulary emphasizes approximate-with-bound.
gaps.target: Separate floating numerical result from certified bounded approximation in status/evidence.

gaps.finding: Current traceability uses a legacy FNV identity chain while public/global semantic distribution needs versioned collision-resistant identity domains.
gaps.target: Version identity algorithms and migrate without invalidating legacy artifacts silently.

gaps.finding: Naming policy says aliases are removed while notation/import systems permit canonical aliases and V15 needs `cypher`→`cipher`.
gaps.target: Distinguish deprecated semantic synonyms from registered accept-many/canon-one surface aliases.

gaps.finding: The standard-library README and capability matrix can drift; for example, support statements about Option/Result may differ by snapshot.
gaps.target: Generate both from the same feature and conformance data.

gaps.finding: Current `custom` documentation spans parser, genesis, and capability descriptions with differing execution status language.
gaps.target: Assign separate FeatureIDs for custom surface, genesis execution, and curated world support.

gaps.finding: A feature can exist in grammar or code without a complete artifact/evidence consequence.
gaps.target: Require projection closure and artifact disposition.

gaps.finding: Current documentation gates have known pre-existing inconsistencies noted in the latest commit.
gaps.target: Make gap radar output a blocking or explicitly waived artifact rather than hidden CI debt.

gaps.finding: There is no automatic check that a domain addition avoided core parser and stable-IR branches.
gaps.target: Add anti-domain-branch architectural lint keyed by FeatureID class.

gaps.finding: No canonical agent handoff/resume object exists.
gaps.target: Task/Context/Change Capsules make restart state explicit.

gaps.finding: Multi-agent semantic conflicts can appear as ordinary file merge conflicts.
gaps.target: Detect semantic and golden conflicts by FeatureID before merge.

gaps.finding: A model may update goldens to match a bug.
gaps.target: Golden changes require ELP/identity/migration authority.

gaps.finding: A provider can be integrated without one generated coverage and evidence view.
gaps.target: Provider Capsules and capability/world matrices are generated.

gaps.finding: No uniform distinction exists between specification completeness and implementation completeness.
gaps.target: Feature maturity and projection/implementation coverage are independent.
